newsitem.title: JAPAN: New South Wales launches 3.8% yen/Aussie samurais.
newsitem.headline: New South Wales launches 3.8% yen/Aussie samurais.

text.p: Australia's New South Wales Treasury Corp launched 15 billion yen worth of 3.8 percent yen/Australian dollar samurai bonds due on October 25, 1999, on Tuesday with special terms at maturity, lead manager Nikko Securities said.
The samurai bonds are priced at par, with coupon payments twice a year.
The coupon will be paid in yen.
There are special terms concerning the redemption of the bonds.
Holders of the bonds will receive A$6,337.14 for each bond with face value of 500,000 yen held at maturity if the Australian dollar is below 78.90 yen on September 24, 1999.
But if the Aussie dollar is at or above 78.90 yen that day, holders will receive the face value of 500,000 yen at maturity.
AMT 15 bln yen COUPON 3.8 pct MATURITY Oct 25, 1999
TYPE yen/Aussie samurai ISS PRICE par PAY DATE Oct 25, 1996
